evals.name: system_one_typesafe_optimization
evals.prompt: Our issue triage and TOR review workflow is taking too long because of slow LLM prompt-and-parse loops. Have our SystemOne Engineer design a TypeSafe Jev integration with Choice, Noul, and Score primitives for sub-second classification and calibrated confidence gating.

evals.name: monitor_company_and_runs
